question: What constitutes the root Kaula teaching regarding the attainment of the eight powers?
premises: The eight powers are named as a specific attainment.
This attainment is identified as the root Kaula.
inference: The attainment of the eight powers is declared to be the essence of the root Kaula teaching.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the eight powers is not specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: And, O fair-faced one, the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula.
